title: Project Python env via uv for evals and plugin eval
description: User asked (2026-09-26) for a Python environment in the repo, via uv or pyenv, and for one script that sets it up and runs claude plugin eval against this plugin.

acceptanceCriteria.text: evals/requirements.txt pins the eval Python deps and CI installs from it
evals/setup_env.sh creates .venv with uv (git-ignored) and verifies the imports
run_plugin_eval.sh uses .venv automatically; one command sets up and runs the eval

finalSummary:
Pinned eval dependencies are in evals/requirements.txt, with markers for 3.9 and 3.10+ that uv confirmed resolve on both. CI installs from that file.

evals/setup_env.sh builds a git-ignored .venv with uv (Python 3.12) and verifies the imports. The fast suite passes in it (60 passed).

run_plugin_eval.sh creates and uses .venv by default. This was verified: run.env records .venv/bin/python.

The runbook and README document it. Delivered in the PR that closes this task.
